findings.claim: ARM-4 consume gate (_dispose, isck_coverage_probes.py:540-567 @36a5514df8): a structurally valid ORPHAN sidecar entry -- no ruling reason, no record link, no ruled_by/source ref, no bundle/rule digest -- suppresses a brand-new live arm as ADJUDICATED (exhibit: 0/0/0/1 -> 1/0/0/0 by swapping only the consumed JSON); _validate_entries ACCEPTS it. A hand/sweep insertion or a stale same-key ruling can hide a live arm while the gate prints disposed/auditable (charter scope item 3)
findings.disposition_basis: ROUTED to the module owner 0.4.0_DT_ClientPlatform~X (scoped override for the pathspec; CTO~X integrates at the citation). Remedy spec: every sidecar entry (ARM-4 AND the new ARM-1 sidecar) carries record_ref (the adjudication .md anchor), ruled_at (commit), and arm_digest (sha256 of the normalized then-clause + value set at adjudication); the loader IGNORES an entry missing any -> the row prints NEW + WARN (fail-open-to-NEW); digest mismatch -> LAPSE (the value-set lapse generalized); both-direction self-controls (orphan rejected; linked ruling accepted; stale-digest lapses; a legitimate current entry still suppresses). Same class as R3-DT-1's lesson: the artifact whose only job is to be trusted must prove its own provenance
findings.verification_ref: CVO~X re-attack at the fix citation (the finder); CRO~X corroborates by construction
